headline: The spire now bites: Lemmings falls past three tiles kill
lede: Slot b took the never-dry rung and tightened the one rule that decided every drop: maxFall 7 goes to 3, as on the Amiga original. THE SPIRE's staircase was re-carved down to the ground and re-proven, floaters suddenly matter, and the audit gained absolute fall pins that catch the value drifting back.

notes.text: CFG.maxFall 7 → 3 — the original's lethality. Walkers off the spire splat; FLOATER's two parachutes are now the difference between a descent and a funeral.

THE SPIRE's east stair secretly ended six tiles above the floor — the old forgiving value made it free. Stepped all the way down; the real solver re-proved win 4/4 with slack and climb still load-bearing.

Fall pins are now absolute (4 tiles must die, short falls land within 3) plus a maxFall=7 drift mutation: the old relative pin stayed green at the very laxity it was meant to catch. lemcheck 157/157, mutate 179/179, lemplay 41/41.

look.text: Fall off the east stair without a parachute — hear the OH NO!
